title: Recursive list encoding
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type and let $f$ encode each element of $\alpha$ as a Boolean word. Encode the empty list as the one-bit word $[\mathrm{false}]$; encode a nonempty list with head $a$ and tail $A$ as $[\mathrm{true}]$ followed by $f(a)$ and then the encoding of $A$.
